newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia tenders to sell stake in trade firm.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia tenders to sell stake in trade firm.

text.p: Tunisia launched an international tender to sell a majority stake in trade firm Societe Tunisienne des Echanges Commerciaux (SOTECOM) as part of its privatisation programme, officials said on Monday.
It said it offers to sell 129,374 shares representing 80.86 percent of SOTECOM'S capital. The nominal price is five dinars for each share.
SOTECOM is a subsidiary of state-controlled Societe Tunisienne de Banques which sells the 80.86 percent stake.
It has a capital of 800,000 dinars. Turnover in 1995 amounted to 3.623 million dinars and net profits were 126,590 dinars.
The company was created in 1966 and trades capital goods for public works.
The deadline for submitting offers was set for January 20, 1997. ($=one dinar)
